summary: Iter 70 — Phase 3 regression complete on web + mobile. Backend pytest: 11/11 green (test_iter70_phase3.py). Verified: (1) POST /api/admin/community-partner/activate — founding partner re-activation preserves founding_partner=true; activate:false reverts to free; unknown email → 404; DB invariant countDocuments({founding_partner:true}) <= 5. (2) Lazy downgrade: user with subscription_expires in the past + tier='premium' auto-flips to 'free' on next GET /api/auth/me and then hits 402 upgrade_required on POST /api/posts. (3) partner_badge fields: /api/u/pugetsoundsailingsoc returns user.partner_badge='founding'; every doc in /api/posts and /api/events includes author_partner_badge / organizer_partner_badge keys (nullable). (4) Hide-on-lapse: /api/boat-pros and /api/crew-bank/standalone exclude entries whose owner subscription_expires < now. (5) Welcome email activation is fire-and-forget — endpoint returned 200 even though EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY paths log 'skipped'. WEB smoke: fresh free boat_owner sees data-testid=upgrade-nudge on /dashboard with functional upgrade-nudge-cta (href='/pricing') + upgrade-nudge-dismiss (30-day localStorage). /u/pugetsoundsailingsoc renders founding-partner-badge ('★ FOUNDING PARTNER'). MOBILE smoke: same free boat_owner sees testID upgrade-nudge on /(tabs)/feed (screenshot confirms banner + × dismiss). Feed cards render founding-partner-badge. /events/seed_ev_2 detail screen renders '★ FOUNDING PARTNER' badge next to 'Hosted by Puget Sound Sailing Society'. No React Native red screens; only pre-existing 'shadow* deprecated' warning (unrelated to this phase).
critical_code_review_comments: deps.current_user_from_token performs a lazy DB write on every authenticated request when a tier is non-free — this is fine, but the write is unconditional inside the try even if subscription_expires is null. The `expd and expd < now` short-circuits it in practice; still worth a metric to confirm no runaway update_ones under load.

admin_router activate: the 'founding' check uses countDocuments({founding_partner: true}) < 5 without a transaction/upsert guard. Two concurrent activations could each read 4 and both write founding_partner=true, resulting in 6 founding partners. Low probability (admin-only endpoint) but worth documenting or wrapping in a findOneAndUpdate on a counter doc.

directory_router.list_boat_pros filters lapsed OWNERS but does not filter by subscription_tier — a user who was demoted to 'free' but still has a stale subscription_expires in the future (edge case: manual DB edits) would still surface. Consider filtering `subscription_tier != 'free'` on the boat_pro owner too.

community_router.list_standalone_crew: same lapse filter; also does not exclude subscription_tier='free' listings created before Phase 2 gating existed. If any legacy free-tier standalone listings remain, they'd still be public.

mailer.community_partner_welcome_email_html HTML-escapes org_name only in badge/founding paths (via `.replace('<','<')` elsewhere) — org_name in the h1 line 'Hi {org_name or there}' is NOT escaped. Low risk (name is set by user themselves and shown to themselves) but worth a helper.

PartnerBadge.jsx renders both testids on the same element via ternary — this is correct. However, on web, when kind is neither 'founding' nor 'partner', the component returns null (good). On mobile partner.tsx the same pattern is used consistently. Parity is clean.

success_rate.frontend: web 3/3 assertions verified live; mobile 3/3 verified live
